note: Three pavings on the edges of the 1904 grid, each at a stage short of completion: the Board of Local Improvements awarded 'Warrant 23879. Curbing, grading and paving with asphalt 16th street, from Michigan avenue to Prairie avenue' to J. H. Covode and 'Warrant 23854. Curbing, grading and paving with asphalt Calumet avenue, from 21st street to 31st street' to the Standard Paving Co. (3 May 1899, pp. 255-256); the Council passed 'A recommendation, ordinance and estimate for curbing, grading and paving (brick) Indiana avenue, from 16th street to 18th street' (22 May 1899, p. 473); and the assessment roll for '23631. Curbing, grading and paving (asphalt) 22d street, from Indiana avenue to Illinois Central Railroad' was filed in the County Court (p. 1068). An award, an ordinance or a filed roll is not a finished street: every surface taken from this volume is INFERRED for 1904, never attested.
what_it_supplies: the material ordered for E. 16th Street (Michigan to Prairie), Calumet Avenue (21st to 31st), Indiana Avenue (16th to 18th) and E. 22nd Street (Indiana to the Illinois Central) in 1899, and who took two of the contracts

a bound on sidewalk materials: the volume's OCR mentions 'cement sidewalk' 453 times, 'plank sidewalk' 631 times and 'cinder sidewalk' 0 times (counted 2026-09-29 for T-1728; a mention may be an order, a repeal or a contract, so the counts are proportions of the city's business, not of walks laid)
what_it_does_not_supply: proof that any of the four was laid, or when
any curb, walk or parkway material
